people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life, and your son Solomon’s life.
translations.bsb: Now please, come and let me advise you. Save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.
translations.kjv: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
translations.asv: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
